Use of eslicarbazepine acetate in these age groups is supported by evidence from adequate and well-controlled studies of eslicarbazepine acetate in adults with partial-onset seizures, pharmacokinetic data from adult and pediatric patients, and safety data from clinical studies in 393 pediatric patients 4 to 17 years of age [see Adverse Reactions ( 6.1 ) and Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.3 )]. Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients below the age of 4 years have not been established.
